rules: Recovery starts only after execution verification reports partial or failed.
Recovery is deterministic and does not make another AI/API request.
Never retry an operation already verified.
Never widen scope: element stays element, section stays section, page stays page, site stays site.
Never silently rebrand, delete content, or replace a Spark during recovery.
Only allow explicitly safe idempotent retries.
At most one recovery pass per user request.
Only verified recovery changes may be reported as completed.
Recovery itself consumes zero additional AI credits.
